description:
Enjoy my magical Christmas themed tour filled with lots of Jolly fun! The festive season is the most wonderful time of year and so I want to share all the beauty London has to offer during the winter season to all of you.

I’ve noticed that so many travellers come to this great city in these cold winter months and don’t truly experience all of London’s Christmas joy; and so I have made it our mission to showcase how unforgettable and spirited a London Christmas can be.

Together you’ll explore London’s winter transformation, showing you wonderful sights, new things and paths never taken before, at the most affordable prices. We’ll start our journey at Tottenham Court Road Station, from there going on to see many more amazing, festive sights. Including the Unforgettable Regent’s Street Christmas Lights, Carnaby Soho Lights, Mayfair’s bright and bold high-class shopping district, famous Oxford Street, London Palladium and much more. The tour ends at the infamous Winter Wonderland where you are free to go on and enjoy a new wonderful adventure. These whimsical walking tours can be enjoyed by everyone so please come down and enjoy a cool Christmas with me.

Please be ware that tours may be cancelled or rescheduled due to low turnout and poor weather conditions.
hostdescription:
Hi! My name is Ollie and I have lived in London for 30 years, I absolutely love this city and enjoy showing off everything it has to offer.
Christmas is my favourite holiday and is a time where London is most peaceful, jolly and beautiful. Everyone is always ready to spread good cheer and I want to share it with you. On my tour I’ll take to new sights and famous places while showing you an amazing irreplaceable experience.

reviews.text: One of the best experiences in London!! Ollie is beyond amazing. I arrived at the wrong meeting point but she patiently redirected me to a nearby location and throughout was jovial and kind. Not to mention the weather condition. It was raining and she still took me round and ensured I got my money’s worth. Totally amazing experience with a warm, welcoming and knowledgeable host. I can’t emphasize enough how fun this whole experience was and I would highly recommend. Completely worthwhile!
